import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('tests/test_semantics.py'); s = p.read_text()
extra = '''
def test_quarantine_unbinds_apps():
    t, _, _ = targets(lease())
    disc = row(type='icmp', id='d', revision=0, published=1, lease='home', event=1, probe='0/i1',
               target=t['0/i1'], responder=t['0/i1'], result='echo')
    bad = base64.b64encode(b'junk').decode()
    app_malformed = row(type='app', id='m', revision=0, published=2, lease='home', event=2,
                        target=t['0/i1'], result='open', service='dev', attempt=0, payload=bad)
    # alias quarantine
    canary = row(type='icmp', id='c', revision=0, published=1, lease='home', event=1, probe='0/c',
                 target=t['0/c'], responder=t['0/c'], result='echo')
    job = campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[service('dev', 'adb')],
                   captures=[capture([disc, app_malformed, canary])])
    res = run(job)
    check('alias lease state', lease_report(res, 'home')['state'], 'alias')
    check('alias unbinds app', res['snapshots'][0]['unbound_applications'], 1)
    check('alias no protocol error', service_report(res, 'home', 'dev')['protocol_errors'], 0)
    check('alias services empty', service_report(res, 'home', 'dev')['internal_open'], [])
    # conflict quarantine
    conflict = row(type='icmp', id='x', revision=0, published=2, lease='home', event=2,
                   probe='0/i2', target=t['0/i2'], responder=t['0/i1'], result='echo')
    job = campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[service('dev', 'adb')],
                   captures=[capture([disc, app_malformed, conflict])])
    res = run(job)
    check('conflict lease state', lease_report(res, 'home')['state'], 'conflict')
    check('conflict unbinds app', res['snapshots'][0]['unbound_applications'], 1)
    check('conflict no protocol error', service_report(res, 'home', 'dev')['protocol_errors'], 0)
    # inactive lease
    job = campaign(leases=[lease(start=0, end=5)], services=[service('dev', 'adb')], queries=[50],
                   captures=[capture([disc, app_malformed])])
    res = run(job)
    check('inactive unbinds app', res['snapshots'][0]['unbound_applications'], 1)
    check('inactive no protocol error', service_report(res, 'home', 'dev')['protocol_errors'], 0)
    # usable lease counts the protocol error
    job = campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[service('dev', 'adb')],
                   captures=[capture([disc, app_malformed])])
    res = run(job)
    check('usable counts protocol error', service_report(res, 'home', 'dev')['protocol_errors'], 1)
    check('usable app not unbound', res['snapshots'][0]['unbound_applications'], 0)

def test_external_witness_causality():
    t, _, _ = targets(lease())
    ext = '2001:db8:aa::5'
    rows = [
        row(type='icmp', id='x', revision=0, published=9, lease='home', event=9, probe='0/i2',
            target=t['0/i2'], responder=ext, result='echo'),
        row(type='app', id='e1', revision=0, published=9, lease='home', event=8, target=ext,
            result='open', service='web', attempt=0),
        row(type='app', id='e2', revision=0, published=9, lease='home', event=9, target=ext,
            result='closed', service='web', attempt=0),
    ]
    res = run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[service()], captures=[capture(rows)]))
    check('app before external witness unbound', res['snapshots'][0]['unbound_applications'], 1)
    svc = service_report(res, 'home', 'web')
    check('external closed after witness', svc['external_closed'], [ext])
    check('external open empty', svc['external_open'], [])
    check('internal_only empty (external open set empty)', svc['internal_only'], [])

def test_multi_subnet_unresolved():
    les = lease(subnets=(0, 2), low_count=2)
    t, _, lows = targets(les)
    res = run(campaign(leases=[les], services=[service()], captures=[capture([
        row(type='icmp', id='d', revision=0, published=1, lease='home', event=1, probe='2/i2',
            target=t['2/i2'], responder=t['2/i2'], result='echo')])]))
    rep = lease_report(res, 'home')
    check('multi subnet internal', rep['internal'], ['2001:db8:1:1202::2'])
    check('multi subnet unresolved', rep['unresolved'],
          ['2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::2', '2001:db8:1:1202::1'])
    check('manifest probes', [m['probe'] for m in manifest_of(res, 'home')],
          ['0/c', '0/i1', '0/i2', '2/c', '2/i1', '2/i2'])

def test_overlapping_leases_isolated():
    a = lease(lid='aa', prefix='2001:db8:1:1200::/56', subnets=(0,), low_count=2)
    b = lease(lid='bb', prefix='2001:db8:1:1200::/56', subnets=(0,), low_count=2)
    ta, _, _ = targets(a)
    tb, _, _ = targets(b)
    rows = [row(type='icmp', id='d', revision=0, published=1, lease='aa', event=1, probe='0/i1',
                target=ta['0/i1'], responder=ta['0/i1'], result='echo')]
    res = run(campaign(leases=[a, b], services=[service()], captures=[capture(rows)]))
    check('lease aa discovers', lease_report(res, 'aa')['internal'], ['2001:db8:1:1200::1'])
    check('lease bb unaffected', lease_report(res, 'bb')['internal'], [])
    check('lease bb unresolved full', lease_report(res, 'bb')['unresolved'],
          ['2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::2'])
    check('lease order lexical', [r['lease'] for r in res['snapshots'][0]['leases']], ['aa', 'bb'])
